what: Second census, after an adversarial review overturned round 1. Measures only what round 2 changed: both files are the SAME tree (5992 tracked files), classified by round-1 code and by round-2 code.
supersedes: This directory's MANIFEST.json and DISTRIBUTION.md, written 2026-07-29T16:12:45Z, state that 'defect 2 was not in this work order and was not looked at'. That was true when written and is false of the branch: check_redlines.py carries the defect-2 fix, and that MANIFEST's own code_under_measurement hash is the hash of the FIXED file. Neither is edited -- MANIFEST.json records DISTRIBUTION.md's sha256, and a provenance record that can be quietly rewritten afterwards is worth less than one corrected in the open. See ADVERSARIAL.md finding 13/14 and RUN_STATE.md.

moves.what_they_are: real ARC scorecard response bodies -- card_id, guid, environments[].id and per-run guids. Every one of them shipped under the sentence 'no record pairs an id with environment payload -- statistics about the games, not material from them'.

verify.note: The same three ? rows as round 1, now naming the real reason (UnicodeDecodeError at a stated offset) instead of an invented one (could not be parsed as JSON). Red is this item's success; the adjudication path that would let a human clear it is raised as R4-ruling-path-for-undetermined.

pytest.note: 10 of the 14 added in round 2 fail on the unfixed tree; the other 4 are positive controls that must pass both before and after.
